Lenkay Motors is a used-car dealership trading from its own premises in Futura, Polokwane. The dealership runs its own website listing pre-owned vehicles for sale, and it is also listed among the independent dealer groups on the Cars online vehicle marketplace, giving buyers a second place to browse what is currently in stock.

The dealership opens on weekdays and again on Saturdays, giving buyers more than one day a week to come in, view vehicles and speak to staff in person. It is based at 68 Vermikuliet Street, Polokwane Ext 8, and suits customers looking to buy a used vehicle from a local, independent dealer rather than a national franchise showroom.

Liberty Life's Bendor office trades under the long-established Liberty brand, one of South Africa's major financial-services groups. Current business records show this branch operating as Liberty Limpopo, categorised as a financial consultant practice connecting local clients with Liberty's broader range of financial-services products and advice, rather than as a single-line insurance outlet.

Clients can deal with staff in person at the office rather than only through a call centre or an online channel, which suits those who prefer face-to-face financial-services support. The office is based at Unit 3, 29 Bendor Drive, Propark, Bendor, and serves clients in and around Polokwane who want a local point of contact for the Liberty brand.

Makgongoana Secondary School is a public secondary school serving learners from Gamakanye Village and the surrounding Ga-Mothapo area near Sovenga, within the Capricorn South education district. Directory records for the school confirm its status as a government secondary school open to children in the local community.

Classes run during standard weekday school hours in line with the South African school calendar, and the school draws its intake mainly from the Ga-Mothapo and wider Mankweng area rather than further afield. It is based in Gamakanye Village along the R71, and serves local families looking for a public secondary school close to home.

Masjid-ul-Firdaus is a mosque in Nirvana, serving as a place of worship for the local Muslim community in Polokwane. It is recorded on directories of South African mosques among the dedicated places of worship serving the area, a point of reference for residents and visitors looking for a mosque in the city.

The mosque stands on the corner of Orient Drive and Himalaya Avenue, Nirvana, Polokwane, set within one of the city's established residential suburbs and within reach of the surrounding neighbourhoods. It serves worshippers from across Polokwane as well as visitors passing through the area who are looking for a place to pray while away from home.

Mathara Investments is a building and construction contractor based in Seshego Zone 1, registered as a close corporation in South Africa since 2009. The company is listed among local building contractors on business directories, with services spanning new builds, extensions and additions, and renovations and remodelling work for residential and other building projects.

The company has remained active on the companies register for well over a decade, and it has appeared as a litigant in a 2024 Limpopo High Court matter, a sign that it continues to operate as a going concern in the building trade. It is registered at 1415 Chris Hani Drive, Seshego Zone 1, Polokwane, and serves customers needing a local contractor for building, extension or renovation work.

Modula S Driving School is a driving school helping learners work towards their learner's and driver's licences. It is listed on a Polokwane business directory alongside its own Facebook page, which gives the school's address and confirms it as an operating driving school currently trading in the city.

Current business information places the school at 84 Church Street, Polokwane Central, rather than the Bendor address previously on file, and the school operates daily to fit around learners' other commitments and work schedules. It suits learner drivers in and around Polokwane who are looking for local, hands-on driving instruction to prepare for their licence tests.

Nedbank Paledi Mall is a branch of Nedbank, one of South Africa's major banks, trading from the Twin City Paledi Shopping Centre in Mankweng. The centre's own tenant directory lists Nedbank among its banking tenants, confirming the branch as a current part of the centre's retail mix, even though the exact shop numbers quoted vary slightly between sources.

The branch keeps both weekday and Saturday banking hours, giving shoppers and residents more than one day a week to handle their banking in person. It serves customers in Mankweng and the surrounding area who need access to everyday banking services without travelling into central Polokwane for a branch visit.

Netsteel Works is a Ladanna-based business operating across machining manufacturing, construction, construction-equipment supply, paving contracting and truck parts. Current business listings categorise the company under these trades rather than as a brick manufacturer, reflecting a broader spread of metalwork, construction and vehicle-parts work than a single product line would suggest.

The business serves construction, paving and truck-parts customers in and around Polokwane who need machined components, construction-related equipment, paving work or truck parts from one local supplier rather than several separate ones. It is based at 37 Lood Street, Ladanna, Polokwane, within reach of the area's other industrial and construction suppliers.

Oude Biek Bottle Store CC is a liquor store in Annadale, listed among Polokwane's liquor outlets and bottle stores on a current local business directory covering the city's licensed liquor trade. It sells beer, wine and spirits to customers across the Annadale area and wider Polokwane.

The store trades on weekdays and again on Saturdays, giving customers more than one day a week to stock up before the weekend or a social occasion. It is based at 82A Pietersburg Street, Annadale, Polokwane, and suits adult customers in the area who want a local, independent bottle store rather than a supermarket liquor counter.

Pharmacy Plus Seshego is a retail pharmacy based in the Seshego Zone 1 area, listed on business directories among the pharmacies serving the wider Seshego community. It offers everyday pharmacy services to residents of Seshego and the surrounding suburbs who need a dispensary close to home.

The pharmacy is open seven days a week, giving residents access to dispensing and everyday health needs outside standard weekday hours too. It trades from the Chris Hani Drive area of Seshego Zone 1, Polokwane, and suits local households who want a nearby pharmacy without travelling into central Polokwane for their medication and health essentials.

Polo is a South African fashion retailer with a branch inside Mall of the North in Bendor, Polokwane. The brand's own store locator lists this branch by name, and it also appears on the centre's own tenant directory among Mall of the North's roster of clothing retailers.

The store trades throughout the week, in line with the centre's regular shopping hours, giving shoppers a consistent window to visit. It is based in Units U52 and U54 at Mall of the North, Bendor, Polokwane, and suits shoppers at the centre who want to browse Polo's clothing range while they are already there for their other shopping.

Rays Florist is a florist trading from Uhuru Lifestyle Emporium in Polokwane Central, with its own website and an Instagram page where it shares photos of its work for followers to see. The florist serves customers across the city looking for flowers for everyday and special occasions.

It is open seven days a week, giving customers the flexibility to call in for flowers on any day, including weekends, rather than only during a standard working week. The shop is based at 42A Grobler Street, Uhuru Lifestyle Emporium, Polokwane, and suits customers across the city wanting a local florist close to Polokwane's centre.

RocoMamas Polokwane is the Greenery branch of the RocoMamas restaurant group, which has more than 100 locations. Its own page describes a burger restaurant built around smashburgers, Mofo hot chicken wings and Rockin ribs, with signature milkshakes on the menu. Each restaurant is described as its own expression of the brand's culture, blending local artistic flair with laid-back tunes, so guests can choose between a relaxed meal and a livelier night out.

The restaurant is in Shop 04 at The Greenery on Grobler Street in Polokwane Ext 4, and it is listed as open seven days a week. It suits groups of friends looking for a relaxed meal or a more energetic night out.

Senhor Peri-Peri is a fast-food restaurant with a branch inside Thornhill Shopping Centre in Polokwane. The brand's own store list confirms this Thornhill branch as one of its current trading locations, and it also appears on the centre's own tenant directory alongside the shopping centre's other stores.

The restaurant trades daily and sees substantial customer activity at this branch, judging by current review volumes for the location. It is based on the corner of Munnik Avenue and Veldspaat Street, Thornhill Estate, Polokwane, and suits customers at the centre who want a quick fast-food meal while they shop or run errands nearby.

Shoprite Seshego Circle is a full-range supermarket inside Seshego Circle Shopping Centre in Seshego, part of the national Shoprite chain. Current catalogue and promotions pages for the branch show it operating as a grocery store with its own bakery and deli counter, as well as a grocery-delivery service for customers who prefer to shop from home.

The store trades throughout the week, giving local households regular access to groceries, fresh bakery items and deli produce without a long drive. It is based at Seshego Circle Shopping Centre, on the corner of Ditlou Street and 27th Avenue, Seshego, and serves local households doing their everyday grocery shopping.

Slayology Beauty Bar is an appointment-based beauty salon in Bendor, listed on a beauty-and-wellness directory alongside its own Instagram page showcasing its work. The salon carries a strong customer rating on that directory, built up from a number of reviews left by clients in the area.

It trades on weekdays and again on Saturdays, giving clients more than one day a week to book an appointment around work or other commitments. The salon is based in the Dental Studio Building at 39 Bendor Drive, Bendor, Polokwane, and suits clients in the area looking for a well-reviewed, appointment-based beauty salon close to home.

Tau Hardware is a hardware store in Ga Thoka, Mankweng, listed on local business directories that record a substantial number of customer reviews for the store. That volume of reviews reflects steady, ongoing trade from the surrounding rural and peri-urban community rather than a quiet or occasional operation.

The store is open throughout the week, including Sunday mornings, giving customers a wide window to pick up hardware and building supplies outside a standard Monday-to-Friday schedule. It is based on the R71 in Ga Thoka, Mankweng, Polokwane, and suits customers in the area needing hardware and building supplies close to home without travelling into town.

Van Der Walt Attorneys is an attorney and civil-law attorney practising from Bendor, Polokwane. The firm is listed on local business directories alongside its own Facebook page and business website as a civil-law practice serving clients in and around the city.

Clients can reach the practice directly at its Bendor office rather than through a call centre, which suits those who prefer dealing directly with a local firm for civil-law matters. The practice is based at Suite 1, Pro Park 1, 29 Bendor Drive, Bendor, Polokwane, and serves clients across Polokwane who need an attorney for civil-law matters rather than other specialisations.

Wimpy Savannah Mall is the Fauna Park branch of the Wimpy family restaurant chain, and its own page describes all-day breakfasts, juicy burgers, toasted sandwiches and thick milkshakes. The menu also includes the Famous Wimpy Grill, a hearty lunch and a quick coffee and light meal for shoppers who want something smaller.

Customers can dine in, grab a takeaway or order online for delivery. The restaurant is in Shop 47/48 at Savannah Mall on Grimm Street in Fauna Park, Polokwane, and the branch describes itself as a child-friendly stop for families visiting the centre. Its own page has separate Kids and Promos sections, so families can check what is on offer before they visit.

Absa Bank Savannah Mall is a branch of Absa, one of South Africa's major banks, offering personal and business banking services to customers in and around Fauna Park. Staff at the branch handle everyday banking needs such as account enquiries, cash transactions and other over-the-counter services for walk-in customers.

It trades on weekdays and on Saturdays, giving shoppers at Savannah Mall a convenient banking stop alongside their other errands at the centre. The branch is in Shop G31 of Savannah Mall, on the corner of Grimm and Thabo Mbeki Street in Fauna Park, Polokwane, and is a practical choice for customers who prefer banking in person.

Ackermans Mankweng Paledi Mall is a branch of the Ackermans fashion chain, stocking clothing, children's clothing and women's clothing for everyday family shopping. As part of a long-established national retailer, it gives Mankweng households an affordable option for school basics, seasonal outfits and everyday wear without a trip into central Polokwane.

The branch's presence at Paledi Mall is confirmed independently of the chain's wider store listings, setting it apart from other Ackermans branches that share the same general chain description. It trades from Shop 47 of Paledi Mall on the R71 in Mankweng, and is geared toward families shopping for clothing across different ages and sizes.

Andries van Zyl Physiotherapist is a physiotherapy practice in Bendor, seeing patients for physiotherapy consultations from its Outspan Drive premises. It is one of the physiotherapy services patients in Bendor and the wider Polokwane area can turn to when they need treatment, and the practice trades under the name of its own practitioner rather than as part of a larger chain.

The practice keeps weekday hours, seeing patients from Monday to Friday and closing over weekends, which suits those wanting to fit an appointment around a working week. Andries van Zyl Physiotherapist is based at 153 Outspan Drive, Bendor, Polokwane, making it a straightforward option for patients in the area needing physiotherapy care close to home rather than travelling further into Polokwane.

AP Kerk Pietersburg is a congregation of the Afrikaanse Protestantse Kerk, based in Welgelegen and gathering the local community for Sunday worship. Visitors describe sermons delivered in their own language and speak of the congregation as a welcoming, peaceful place to connect with faith and fellow worshippers, with several reviews commenting on the quality of its services.

The church holds its Sunday service for the congregation and keeps separate weekday office hours for enquiries and administration, and the building offers a wheelchair-accessible entrance for visitors. AP Kerk Pietersburg is based at 89 Diemeer Street, Welgelegen, Polokwane, and welcomes both regular congregants and visitors looking for a place of Christian worship in the area.

Its listing is corroborated across more than one current business directory, confirming it as an active veterinary and animal-feed operation at this address rather than a lapsed one. Capricorn Animal Health is based at 18C Witklip Street, Ladanna, Polokwane, and serves both household pet owners and farming customers needing animal care or feed close to home.

Checkers The Greenery is a full-range supermarket at The Greenery shopping centre in Polokwane, combining grocery shopping with an in-store bakery, butchery, deli and coffee shop under one roof. Shoppers can also pick up fresh fruit and vegetables or arrange grocery delivery, covering most of a household's weekly shop in one visit.

As one of the centre's key tenants, it draws shoppers who are also visiting The Greenery's other stores, while still carrying the backing of the national Checkers chain behind its in-house departments. The store trades from The Greenery shopping centre in Polokwane, suiting households doing a full grocery shop alongside a stop at the bakery or butchery counter.

Elda Panelbeaters is a panel-beating and spray-painting workshop in Ladanna, handling body repairs for both passenger cars and commercial vehicles of all kinds. The workshop is SAMBRA approved and carries its own listed profile with the association, placing it among the repairers recognised for meeting the industry's standards for collision and body-repair work.

That accreditation gives vehicle owners and insurers a recognised standard to rely on when choosing where to have accident or collision damage repaired. Elda Panelbeaters is based at 4 Silver Street, Ladanna, Polokwane, and serves vehicle owners needing panel-beating, spray-painting or body-repair work carried out to an accredited, association-recognised standard.

It sees patients from Fauna Park and the wider Polokwane area for dental treatment and routine check-ups, and keeps an active social-media page where it shares updates and photos between visits.

The practice runs from its Fauna Park premises during the working week, giving patients in the suburb a local dentist rather than one further into Polokwane. Gelmar Baobab is the Baobab Gardens branch of Gelmar, a home-improvement and DIY retailer that says it has been South Africa's trusted partner for 90 years. The store stocks hardware and homeware, with kitchen fittings such as cupboard hinges, drawer runners, handles, baskets and storage accessories, plus bathroom, bedroom, decor, electrical, tools, taps, locks and sinks.

Staff give expert advice on projects, and the branch runs monthly promotions on home-improvement essentials that customers can shop in store or online. Payment can be made by cash, card or Google Pay. The shop is at Shop LO3 on Aloe Vera Street in Baobab Gardens, Thornhill Estate, Polokwane, and suits homeowners and DIY enthusiasts planning kitchen, bathroom or storage upgrades.

Hairby Ntshunxeko is a hair salon in Seshego, taking clients for hair-salon services from its Zone 8 premises. The salon has built a large following across more than one social-media platform, where past clients tag and share photos of their finished styles, giving new clients a way to see its work before booking.

Bookings are taken by appointment rather than on a walk-in basis, with clients reaching the salon directly to arrange a time. Hairby Ntshunxeko is based at 17 141st Street, Seshego-H, Polokwane, and suits clients in Seshego and the surrounding area who are after a local hair salon that works strictly by appointment.

HiFiCorp is a branch of the HiFiCorp consumer-electronics and appliance retail chain, confirmed as a current store on the chain's own official store locator. It stocks electronics and appliances ranging from televisions and audio equipment to major and small household appliances, for home and business customers shopping in Polokwane.

The branch keeps its own listed trading hours on the chain's store locator, separate from the group's general national pages, confirming it as an active, currently trading branch. HiFiCorp trades from Shop 14 of the Polokwane Lifestyle Centre, on the corner of Landros Mare and Market Streets, Polokwane, and is a destination for customers needing consumer electronics or household appliances in the area.

Hino Limpopo is a truck dealership in Thornhill, selling new and used Hino trucks and supplying genuine truck parts to businesses and individuals across the region. The dealership has built up a substantial number of customer reviews online, including positive feedback about the way its service department has handled work.

It keeps weekday trading hours for sales, parts and aftersales enquiries, and operates as part of the wider Hino dealer network across the region. Hino Limpopo is based on the corner of Munnik and Veldspaat Streets, Thornhill, Polokwane, and serves businesses and individuals in the region needing a new or used truck, truck parts, or dealership support.

Kay Medical Centre is a medical centre in Polokwane Central, housing a number of separate medical practices within the same building. Specialties represented on-site include neurosurgery and dermatology, alongside a dialysis centre operating from the same address, giving patients access to a range of specialist care without moving between different buildings.

The building works as a shared base for these practices rather than a single practice in its own right, so patients attend by arrangement with whichever practice they need to see. Kay Medical Centre is based at 64 Plein Street, Polokwane Central, Polokwane, and is a point of access to several medical specialties under one roof.

The Farmyard itself is described as an open-air lifestyle and dining destination bringing together restaurants, specialty shops and food outlets, with this KFC branch forming part of its dining line-up.

Visitors to The Farmyard Trading Post can stop at this KFC branch alongside the centre's other restaurants and shops in the same open-air setting. KFC The Farmyard trades from The Farmyard Trading Post, on the corner of Munnik and School Street, Bendor, Polokwane, and is a fast-food chicken option for anyone visiting the centre.

Ladannah Hardware is a hardware and general store in Annadale, known locally as "the old Limpopo Store". The business describes itself on its own page as covering a broad range of hardware and everyday household needs, giving customers in Annadale and the surrounding area a single local stop for building materials and general supplies.

That local nickname, distinct from the Ladannah Hardware name on the shopfront, is still how many regular customers refer to the store, and it is listed under the hardware-shop category on its own business page. Ladannah Hardware trades from 16 Witklip Street, Annadale, Polokwane, and is useful for customers needing hardware and general-store products without travelling further into Polokwane.
